text:
Best plan found: Orbit, then Marquee, then two Kestrel months. It catches 53 (episode, follower) pairs and costs $60.96. I compared the main alternatives by hand but did not search every possible plan, so a better one is possible though I found none.

**Constraints that shape the plan**
- From Nov 1–9, four services already have paid access, which exceeds the limit of 1. From Nov 10–29, Tidewell's paid access uses the only slot. So no new period can start before Nov 30.
- With only one service allowed at a time, the plan is a chain of one-month blocks starting no earlier than Nov 30. About four blocks fit before the last Kestrel episode on Mar 19.
- Pebble Kids is required and always on, so The Velvet Garden, Copper Archive and The Glass Harbor are always covered.

**Chosen plan (53 pairs caught)**

| Period | Service | What it covers | Pairs caught |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dec 2 – Jan 2 | Orbit | The Distant Ferry (all 8 for Eli) and The Salt Atlas episodes 1–4 for Jun | 12 |
| Jan 2 – Feb 2 | Marquee | The Northern Ferry: episodes 5–7 for all three followers, episode 4 for Ines and Mara, episode 3 for Ines | 12 |
| Feb 2 – Mar 2 | Kestrel+ | The Salt Harbor episodes 3–6 and The Silver Signal episodes 1–4 | 20 |
| Mar 2 – Apr 2 | Kestrel+ | The Silver Signal episodes 5–7 | 9 |

**Alternatives compared**

| Alternative | Pairs caught |
|---|---|
| Lumen or Marquee instead of Orbit in the first block (Kestrel blocks unchanged) | 52 |
| Marquee in mid-December, then Kestrel from Jan 19 and Feb 20 (covers all of Kestrel) | 51 |
| Orbit, Marquee from Jan 12 to catch The Distant Atlas, then Kestrel from Feb 12 and Mar 12 | 51 |

**What gets missed (51 pairs)**
- Everything on Lumen: The Velvet Tide (12) and The Hollow Meridian (12).
- The Distant Atlas (10).
- The Salt Atlas episodes 5–9 (5).
- Early Northern Ferry slots (9).
- The Salt Harbor episodes 1–2 (4).

**Cost:** $10.99 + $13.99 + $17.99 + $17.99 = $60.96.
